2609.04894.title: From Language Models to World-Acting Systems: Progress and Limits of Agentic AI across Digital, Social, Virtual, and Physical Environments
2609.04894.paper_summary: Large language models become consequential agents when surrounding systems let outputs change external state. Models now call tools, operate interfaces, delegate work, retain state, inhabit generated worlds, and control robots or laboratory equipment. Such advances are often narrated as one march toward autonomy, conflating model competence, system integration, persistence, and safe authority. This critical review synthesizes primary research and official technical specifications available by 31 August 2026. We organize the evidence along delegated authority, temporal persistence, and environmental coupling, while separating model, harness, and environment. Within the evidence examined, action-interface expansion is documented more convincingly than robust completion, recovery, authorization, or independent verification. Model Context Protocol and Agent2Agent improve interoperability but do not establish trustworthy delegation; multi-agent organization adds specialization alongside cost and correlated failure. Persistent simulations and world models support training and planning but do not themselves demonstrate agency; robotics and self-driving laboratories establish bounded feasibility rather than unattended open-world reliability. We propose justified delegation as an analytical and normative heuristic, not an observed law or certified score: expand action scope only where evidence supports provenance, bounded authority, failure detection, safe recovery, and calibrated human control. This framing yields a research agenda for coupled model-harness evaluation, capability-based permissions, durable state, cross-agent accountability, and staged physical validation.
2609.04894.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型在周圍系統允許輸出改變外部狀態時，成為重要的代理。模型現在可以調用工具、操作介面、委派工作、保持狀態、居住在生成的世界中，並控制機器人或實驗室設備。這些進展通常被敘述為朝向自主性的一次行進，混淆了模型能力、系統整合、持久性和安全權威。這篇批判性評論綜合了截至2026年8月31日可用的主要研究和官方技術規範。我們根據委派權威、時間持久性和環境耦合來組織證據，同時區分模型、工具和環境。在所檢查的證據中，行動介面的擴展比穩健的完成、恢復、授權或獨立驗證更具說服力。模型上下文協議和Agent2Agent改善了互操作性，但並未建立可信的委派；多代理組織增加了專業化，同時伴隨著成本和相關失敗。持久的模擬和世界模型支持訓練和規劃，但本身並不展示代理性；機器人技術和自駕實驗室建立了有限的可行性，而非無人監管的開放世界可靠性。我們提出合理的委派作為一種分析和規範的啟發式，而不是觀察到的法律或認證分數：僅在證據支持來源、有限權威、失敗檢測、安全恢復和經過校準的人類控制的地方擴展行動範圍。這種框架為耦合模型-工具評估、基於能力的許可、持久狀態、跨代理問責和分階段的實體驗證提供了一個研究議程。
2609.04894.author: Linsen Zhu et.al.
